title: MSFS Marketplace Update (Mar 22) ✈️ NEW ZUGY Guiyang Intl & SBEK Javareacanga + US Landmarks!
description:
Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update (March 22, 2026): New MSFS Airports and Scenery! In this week's MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update, we are exploring the best new PC releases, featuring the massive ZUGY Guiyang Longdongbao International Airport by SamScene3D and the remote SBEK Jacareacanga for your next bush flying adventure.

If you are looking for the best MSFS scenery 2026, this update covers everything from major international hubs to detailed US city landmarks.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Heaven Design & BLG: SBEK Javareacanga (Remote Amazonian airstrip perfect for bush flying ops)
🛫 SamScene3D: ZUGY Guiyang Longdongbao International Airport (Major Chinese international hub)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 DFFlyerdirect: Landmarks Jacksonville (Enhanced Florida city skyline)
🌆 DFFlyerdirect: Landmarks Milwaukee (Detailed Midwest urban environment)
